shortDescription: Shares of Netflix NASDAQ:NFLX slipped about 3.5% in the premarket trading on Friday after Wells Fargo downgraded the streaming platform to Underweight from Equal Weight and cut its price target to $57 from $80, citing concerns over engagement trends and the streaming company’s content strategy.New…
